```{r}
#' The goal of this code is to re-format QC data into a standard CSV format 
#' 
#' David Rach at the UMGCC FCSS developed a website to display the Daily QC for the core's instrument.  In
#' addition to the homepage pass fail indications David tracks the performane using Levey-Jennings Plots. 
#' This looks like a nice bit of Instrument analysis that it would be great to bring to the UNC Flow Core.
#' 
#' 4/30/2026
#' We are trying to piece together the steps and so far we have working code to process Cytek Aurora  
#' QC files into a CSV format using Luciernaga:::QC_FilePrep_DailyQC
#' 

# Library Calls
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(Luciernaga)

# Define Path to all the Instrument QC data 
Data <- file.path("C:","Users", "Bob", "Documents", "R-coding", "UNC-Flow-Core-QC-website", "Instrument QCs")

# Define Path, and output location/filename for each instrument
AuroraData <- file.path(Data, "Aurora")
AuroraArchive <- file.path(AuroraData, "Archive", "ArchivedDataAurora.csv")

Attune1Data <- file.path(Data, "Attune1")
Attune1Archive <- file.path(Attune1Data, "Archive", "Attune1Archive.csv")

Attune2Data <- file.path(Data, "Attune2")
Attune2Archive <- file.path(Attune2Data, "Archive", "Attune2Archive.csv")

FortessaData <- file.path(Data, "Fortessa")
FortessaArchive <- file.path(FortessaData, "Archive", "FortessaArchive.csv")

MelodyData <- file.path(Data, "Melody")
MelodyArchive <- file.path(MelodyData, "Archive", "MelodyArchive.csv")

AriaIIData <- file.path(Data, "AriaII")
AriaIIArchive <- file.path(AriaIIData, "Archive", "AriaIIArchive.csv")

S6Data <- file.path(Data, "S6")
S6Archive <- file.path(S6Data, "Archive", "S6Archive.csv")

# Define search Patterns to find file of interest in case of mixed files in Data folders
CSV_Pattern <- ".CSV$"
Attune_Results_Pattern <- "Results.XML$"
Attune_LaserDelay_Pattern <- "LaserDelay.XML$"
FCS_Pattern <- ".fcs$"

# Generate a Vector with the data files of interest 
Aurora_CSV_Files <- list.files(path=AuroraData, pattern=CSV_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
Aurora_FCS_Files <- list.files(path=AuroraData, pattern=FCS_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

Attune1_Results_Files <- list.files(path=Attune1Data, pattern=Attune_Results_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
Attune1_Delay_Files <- list.files(path=Attune1Data, pattern=Attune_LaserDelay_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

Attune2_Results_Files <- list.files(path=Attune2Data, pattern=Attune_Results_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
Attune2_Delay_Files <- list.files(path=Attune2Data, pattern=Attune_LaserDelay_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

Fortessa_CSV_Files <- list.files(path=FortessaData, pattern=CSV_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

Melody_CSV_Files <- list.files(path=MelodyData, pattern=CSV_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

AriaII_CSV_Files <- list.files(path=AriaIIData, pattern=CSV_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

S6_CSV_Files <- list.files(path=S6Data, pattern=CSV_Pattern, full.name=TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

# Process QC files to a TidyCSV similar to those in David's website Data/"Instrument"/Archive folder
AuroraTidyData <- map_dfr(Aurora_CSV_Files, QC_FilePrep_DailyQC)
# We may need to generate a gating scheme to get MFI data out of the Aurora .fcs files -- Skip for now

# Attune1TidyData <- map_dfr(Attune1_Results_Files & Attune1_Delay_Files, Function to Format these XMLs)
# Attune2TidyData <- map_dfr(Attune2_Results_Files & Attune2_Delay_Files, Function to Format these XMLs)
# FortessaTidyData <- map_dfr(Fortessa_CSV_Files, Function to Format these CSVs)
# MelodyTidyData <- map_dfr(Melody_CSV_Files, Function to Format these CSVs)
# AriaIITidyData <- map_dfr(AriaII_CSV_Files, Function to Format these CSVs)
# S6TidyData <- map_dfr(S6_CSV_Files, Function to Format these CSVs) 

# Output the processed files
write.csv(AuroraTidyData, AuroraArchive, row.names=FALSE)
```
